(3) Extension Clause: The buyer can extend the contract upto 06 months with willingness from t he firm. The sole discretion for the extension will remain with buyer. (4) Termination clause: The agreement shall be come to end either on completion of the contract period or shall be terminated for the following reason: 4.1 Mutual consent 4.2 Breach of contractual obligations 4.3 Breach of SLA (5) Payment Terms and Condition: Work completion certificate will be given to the firm post completion of wo rk. Thereafter, the firm has to provide bill to the unit, which will be processed su bsequently and payment will be disbursed by CDA to the firm. (6) Firm have to adhere of scope of work i.e. attached in bid for completion of work and an undertaking certificate has to be uploaded for the same. (7) Geographical Presence of Office Registration Certificate: The bidder/service provider must have a registered office/service support centr e geographically located within the State of Consignee and the office shall be re gistered in the name of the bidder/bidding firm. A Notary Affidavit alone shall no t be accepted as proof of office presence. The bidder is required to submit valid documentary evidence such as Electricity Bill, Telephone/Internet Bill, GST Regi stration, Property Tax Receipt, Rent Agreement, Trade Licence or any other Gov ernment-issued document establishing the operational office within the State of Consignee. The requirement of mandatory geographical presence within the State of Consignee is essential considering the critical and technical nature of work invol ved in supply, installation, inspection, fitment support, maintenance and after-s ales service of Bullet Proof Morcha. The service provider shall be capable of ens uring immediate on-ground coordination, prompt response during operational r equirements, site visits, rectification of defects, technical assistance and timely execution of work whenever required. Availability of local office/support infrastr ucture is necessary to ensure uninterrupted serviceability, faster response time and effective coordination with the consignee throughout the contract period.(9 ) Non-Disclosure Declaration Certificate: Tenderer has to declare on bidder letter head that I shall not disclose the contract of any provision, plans or information thereof to any third party during and after expiry of contract. (10) Warranty Clause. The firm shall mandatorily provide Five (05) years comprehensive onsite warranty for the quoted item. A duly signed undertaking to this effect shall be u ploaded along with the bid. Non-submission of the undertaking shall render the bid liable for rejection.

The warranty period shall commence strictly from the date of successful i nstallation and commissioning of the item at consignee location. The firm shall deliver, install and commission the item along with all requisite ac cessories within 30 (Thirty) days from the date of award of contract. . 10.
